name: Diana Peschka Holly Eryngii
original_name: ディアナ・ペシュカ・ホリー・エリンギ
source: Diana is a daughter of the Prime Minister Eryngii. She falls in love with Cliff at first sight at the ball. Later, she works at Korogaru Ringotei with Leticia.
